newsitem.title: USA: TALX posts Q2 pro forma EPS of $0.04.
newsitem.headline: TALX posts Q2 pro forma EPS of $0.04.

text.p: TALX Corp, which will release full earnings details on Monday, said pro forma per-share earnings from continuing operations were $0.04 for the second quarter ended September 30, based on pro forma weighted average shares outstanding of 3.4 million.

TALX said earnings from continuing operations in the quarter were $125,000, up 16 percent from the same fiscal 1996 period. It said revenues for the quarter were $4.6 million, up 27 percent over the same year-ago period.
The company, which provides interactive voice response systems, went public on October 16.
